title: Rewards Program Terms for Personal Credit Cards: Earning Rates and Bonus Categories
content:
The rewards currency of a tier of Personal Credit Cards is one of three things: none, cash back or points. A tier that earns at all earns at a base rate per whole dollar of net purchases outside its bonus categories, and at a bonus rate per whole dollar within them, up to a stated amount of bonus-category purchases per calendar quarter.

| Tier | Rewards currency | Base rate per dollar | Bonus categories | Bonus rate per dollar | Bonus-category purchases per calendar quarter earning the bonus rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | none | 0 | none | 0 | not applicable |
| College Rewards Visa | cash back | 1 | dining, grocery | 2 | 1000.00 USD |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | none | 0 | none | 0 | not applicable |
| Cash Rewards Visa | cash back | 1.5 | grocery, gas, dining | 3 | 2500.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | points | 1 | travel, dining | 3 | no cap |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | points | 1.5 | travel, dining | 3 | no cap |

Two tiers, Secured Visa and Platinum Low Rate Visa, carry no rewards currency and earn at 0 on every purchase. Of the four that earn, two are cash back and two are points. The quarterly amount earning the bonus rate is capped only on the two cash back tiers, at 1000.00 USD on College Rewards Visa and 2500.00 USD on Cash Rewards Visa; both points tiers carry no cap. Cash Rewards Visa carries the widest set of bonus categories, grocery, gas and dining, while the two points tiers share travel and dining. The highest base rate of the six, 1.5 per dollar, is carried by Cash Rewards Visa and Visa Infinite Private Client alike, and the highest bonus rate, 3 per dollar, by every tier except College Rewards Visa, which earns 2.
